description: This file defines a JavaScript module that provides a function 'listOrganizations' to fetch and process a list of organization tenants from an API endpoint. It utilizes an API client to make HTTP GET requests, normalizes different possible data structures for organization data, and returns a sorted array of organization objects with 'id' and 'name' properties.

methods.name: listOrganizations()
methods.description: Fetches a list of organizations (tenants) for the current user, normalizes data variants, sorts the list, and returns it.
